s.zh: 神眷影响确信度
信奉带神祇模因（或众神殿）的主文化的殖民者，每天按守护神神眷改变确信度：≥80 +1%，≥50 +0.5%，≤-30 -1%；季度显圣赐福 +5%、降罚 -5%；神选仪式 +3%。
s.en: Colonists of a primary ideoligion with a deity meme (or a pantheon) change certainty each day by the patron's favor: ≥80 +1%, ≥50 +0.5%, ≤-30 -1%; seasonal blessing +5%, punishment -5%; chosen ritual +3%.

s.zh: 文化锁定守护神
主文化带神祇模因时，殖民地的守护神就是那位神，不能在圣坛上手动换；重塑文化换了神时自动改奉（旧神神眷只扣15，没有冷却）。
s.en: When the primary ideoligion has a deity meme, the colony's patron deity is that god and can't be changed by hand at the altar; when a reformed ideoligion changes god, the colony switches automatically (the old god only loses 15 favor, no cooldown).

s.en: For DND factions missing DND memes (Faerûn Frontier Alliance, Thayan expedition, Ember Clan, Underdark Hive, witch-hunting zealots, Larloch, Church of Kelemvor), generate a new ideoligion from the faction definition and set it as primary. The old ideoligion is kept: existing NPCs still follow it, and people appearing later use the new one.\n\nFor saves from before 1.56.0. Continue?
